question: Under which of the following Seismic Zones do the Andaman and Nicobar Islands fall?
solution:
The correct answer is__** "Zone V**". __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zone- V** comprises of entire **northeastern India,** the **corridor of Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttaranchal, Rann of Kutch in Gujarat, a corridor of North Bihar and Andaman & Nicobar Islands. **
 
• **The Alpine- Himalayan seismic belt extending up to Andaman- Nicobar islet region**, is known to be one of the **seismically active belts of the world. **
 
• **The A&N islands are in the most severe seismic zone, and the eastern seacoast of India is in the moderate-to-low seismic zone ͑ source BIS 2002. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A seismic zone is used to describe an area where earthquakes tend to concentrate; for illustration, the **New Madrid Seismic Zone** in the Central **United States **
 
• **A seismic hazard zone describes an area with a particular position of hazard due to earthquakes. **
 
• As per the seismic zoning chart of the country**, the total area is classified into four seismic zones.** **Zone V is seismically the most active region, while zone II is the least. **__
 
• Different Seismic Zones Of India 
 __
 
• **Seismic Zone II**__ - **Zone II is classified as the low-damage threat zone. **
 
• __**Seismic Zone III**__ - **Seismic Zone 3/ III is classified as the moderate-damage threat zone**. 
 
• **__Seismic Zone IV__** - **Zone IV is considered the high-damage threat zone. **
 
• __**Seismic Zone V**__ - **Zone V has the loftiest threat of damaging earthquakes. **
 
 
 
• Seismic zonation chart of India, published by__** Bureau of Indian norms( IS- 2002)**__.
